additions.site_name: Google The Dalles former smelter campus
additions.name: Google The Dalles former smelter campus — existing operations

status.summary: On November 19, Google reported that it had developed its third The Dalles campus on the former aluminum smelter property and that the site was providing jobs and tax revenue for Wasco County.

locator.method: Official statewide address point, matched to the planning application by street address and spatially verified against the county assessor’s parcel in the state resolution.
locator.precision: Campus property address point at 3500 River Road. It represents the developed property, without identifying any individual building.
locator.identity_review: The application confirms the River Road street address. The county’s spatial query returns exactly one Design LLC parcel, matching tax lot 700 identified in the state’s first-project resolution.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The state address record supplies no numerical positional accuracy for this individual point.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 196 has no The Dalles facility or project alias. The operator distinguishes this former smelter property from its first two campuses in the city. The two state tax agreements concern separate projects on this one River Road property.
additions.successor_review: The first SIP project held an occupancy certificate by November 2024. Google subsequently reported separate operating performance for its third campus and describes the developed former-smelter site in November 2026. No current milestone for the second SIP building has been established.

additions.name: Logosoft Sarajevo Data Centar — existing commercial operations

status.summary: On November 17, 2026, Logosoft offered business storage and cloud services through its named Logosoft Data Centar in Sarajevo.

locator.method: Centroid of the named OpenStreetMap host building footprint, calculated in WGS84 / UTM zone 34N and returned in WGS84.
locator.precision: Representative point for the host building at Vilsonovo šetalište 9. The position of Logosoft within the building is unspecified.
locator.identity_review: The operator names the exact host building and civic address. The university confirms this commercial facility is located in the building. The open map identifies the same Sarajevo host building.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The map provides no numerical positional accuracy for this derived host-building point.

additions.distinctness_review: Snapshot 196 has no Bosnian physical sites or projects. The customer offer names the operator’s commercial Logosoft Data Centar. Its Sarajevo host building is distinct from the company’s general office and from its partners’ facilities in Banja Luka.
additions.successor_review: The operator’s November commercial offer concerns the same named data center as its property announcement and commercial colocation specification. No later closure, move or renamed facility was identified through November 26.

additions.site_identity_review: Borealis, the host municipality’s representative and the industry federation identify the existing Blönduós campus. The inherited locator represents the same parent campus.

status.summary: Húnabyggð’s municipal executive described ongoing commercial data storage at Borealis’s Blönduós campus on September 6, 2026.

locator.identity_review: Borealis, the host municipality’s representative and the industry federation identify the existing Blönduós campus. The inherited locator represents the same parent campus.

additions.distinctness_review: The 196 project covers construction of a new data centre. The municipal interview and the October industry study distinguish the existing operating campus from that new building.
additions.successor_review: The October industry study confirms ongoing campus operation. The November site report distinguishes the older buildings from the new data centre under construction.

status_updates.name: Data4 Athens (Hermes) DC01 — first phase
status_updates.identity_review: The original October record covers completed first-phase spaces in DC01. Both primary disclosures specifically identify the first phase of DC01 at Data4’s Athens campus in Paiania.
status_updates.successor_review: Growthfund confirms continuing operation on November 16. Data4 subsequently distinguishes the operational first phase from the second phase planned for 2027.

status.summary: Growthfund confirmed on November 16 that DC01’s first phase had operated since July 2026.
